tutorial.info: Round, declarer (team and contract value), trump, and each team's score are shown here. The first team to reach the target points (default 45) wins. The ★ marks the declarer.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the current trick appear here. Follow the led suit. The top trumps (trump 5 > trump J > ♥A > trump A …) are exempt from following (Reneging). The highest card wins the trick.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. During play, click a playable card and press Play.
tutorial.actions: In the bidding phase, buttons appear for Pass / 15 / 20 / 25 (Jink). Only a bid higher than the current highest is selectable. The highest bidder's team declares trump and plays five tricks. Each trick is worth 5 points. Make the contract to score, miss it to lose your bid. A 25 Jink wins instantly if you take all five tricks.
